title: A Spire for the Wolf
author: Orsen Delacroix
blurb: Noor Thackeray, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
